values.note: Four primitive sites. Catalog vehicle lengths: site 1 20 ft, site 2 24 ft, site 3 32 ft, site 4 40 ft (all typed pull-through). Site 1 sits on a knoll on the west shore, apart from the others: 'Trailers are NOT recommended unless they are set up in the parking area at the base of the knoll'. Site 2 is level, for 'small trailers', with 'very limited' turn-around space. Site 3 (65 x 35 ft) 'can accommodate two families and trailers'; site 4 is 80 x 70 ft. Sites 3 and 4 adjoin and can be booked together. Site 1 takes 8 people, sites 2-4 take 16.

note: Four primitive campsites on Swan Lake, Hiawatha NF, off CR 440 and FR 2258/2725 (site 1 via FR 2013) north of US-2 via Forest Highway 13. All four are on the non-motorized Pine Marten Run Trail, and horses are allowed (2-6 per site). Good swimming at every site; large- and smallmouth bass, bluegill and pumpkinseed. The most popular lake in the forest's designated-campsite program, so permits are competitive. --Claude
summary: FS page (updated 2026-09-12) + rec.gov API/rates + RIDB: 4 sites (confirmed) to 40 ft (new), no hookups and no drinking water (confirmed), three primitive toilets, $8 (confirmed, 2026 and 2027), reservation only on rec.gov with walk-ins not allowed (fcfs never, 14-night max, booking season from mid-May), season May 15 - Columbus Day (new). FS-run, no concessionaire. For a 23-ft motorhome: sites 3 (32 ft, 'can accomodate ... trailers') and 4 (40 ft) are drivable; site 2's catalog says 24 ft but it is for 'small trailers' with very limited turn-around; site 1 (20 ft, trailers not recommended up the knoll) is not. Phone 906-474-6442 matches the FS district. Alerts: none names CR 440, FR 2258, FR 2725 or FR 2013. Note trimmed of field restatements.
